revisit_if: a model not in measured_on.models, a Claude Code minor version not in measured_on.claude_code_versions, a model's context window changing, or four weeks after measured_on.date: re-run bin/remeasure.py and compare its suggested floor with floor_tokens. The dashboard panel is not a trigger: it shows whether handoffs keep conversations below the floor (weighted by cache-read tokens over 24h), not whether the floor fits.
